sa: भूय एव महाबाहो श्रृणु मे परमं वचः।
tr: bhūya eva mahābāho śrṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ
en: Hear again, mighty-armed, my supreme word, which I will speak for your good, since you delight in it.
speaker: Krishna said

sa: न मे विदुः सुरगणाः प्रभवं न महर्षयः।
tr: na me viduḥ suragaṇāḥ prabhavaṃ na maharṣayaḥ
en: Neither the hosts of gods nor the great sages know my origin, for I am the source of the gods and the great sages in every way.
Whoever knows me as unborn and beginningless, the great lord of the worlds, is undeluded among mortals and freed from all wrongs.

sa: सुखं दुःखं भवोऽभावो भयं चाभयमेव च ॥
tr: sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhavo'bhāvo bhayaṃ cābhayameva ca
en: Understanding, knowledge, freedom from delusion, patience, truth, self-restraint, calm, pleasure and pain, birth and death, fear and fearlessness,

sa: भवन्ति भावा भूतानां मत्त एव पृथग्विधाः ॥
tr: bhavanti bhāvā bhūtānāṃ matta eva pṛthagvidhāḥ
en: non-violence, equanimity, contentment, austerity, generosity, fame and infamy: these many states of beings arise from me alone.

sa: मद्भावा मानसा जाता येषां लोक इमाः प्रजाः ॥
tr: madbhāvā mānasā jātā yeṣāṃ loka imāḥ prajāḥ
en: The seven great sages of old and the four Manus, born of my mind, share my nature; from them come all the creatures of the world.

sa: एतां विभूतिं योगं च मम यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः।
tr: etāṃ vibhūtiṃ yogaṃ ca mama yo vetti tattvataḥ
en: Whoever truly knows this glory and power of mine is united with me in unshakable yoga; of this there is no doubt.

sa: अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्तः सर्वं प्रवर्तते।
इति मत्वा भजन्ते मां बुधा भावसमन्विताः ॥
tr: ahaṃ sarvasya prabhavo mattaḥ sarvaṃ pravartate
iti matvā bhajante māṃ budhā bhāvasamanvitāḥ
en: I am the source of everything; from me everything unfolds. Knowing this, the wise worship me, full of devotion.

sa: कथयन्तश्च मां नित्यं तुष्यन्ति च रमन्ति च ॥
tr: kathayantaśca māṃ nityaṃ tuṣyanti ca ramanti ca
en: Their minds on me, their lives given to me, enlightening one another and always speaking of me, they are content and full of joy.

sa: ददामि बुद्धियोगं तं येन मामुपयान्ति ते ॥
tr: dadāmi buddhiyogaṃ taṃ yena māmupayānti te
en: To those who are always united with me and worship me with love, I give the yoga of understanding by which they come to me.
Out of compassion for them, dwelling in their hearts, I destroy the darkness born of ignorance with the shining lamp of knowledge.

sa: परं ब्रह्म परं धाम पवित्रं परमं भवान्।
tr: paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma pavitraṃ paramaṃ bhavān
en: You are the supreme Brahman, the supreme abode, the supreme purifier, the eternal divine Person, the first god, unborn and all-pervading.
speaker: Arjuna said

sa: असितो देवलो व्यासः स्वयं चैव ब्रवीषि मे ॥
tr: asito devalo vyāsaḥ svayaṃ caiva bravīṣi me
en: So all the sages have said of you: the divine sage Narada, and Asita, Devala and Vyasa; and now you yourself tell me.

sa: न हि ते भगवन् व्यक्तिं विदुर्देवा न दानवाः ॥
tr: na hi te bhagavan vyaktiṃ vidurdevā na dānavāḥ
en: All that you tell me, Keshava, I take as true. Neither the gods nor the demons, Lord, know your manifestation.
You alone know yourself by yourself, Supreme Person, source of beings, lord of beings, god of gods, lord of the world.
Please tell me fully of your divine glories, the glories by which you pervade these worlds and abide in them.

sa: केषु केषु च भावेषु चिन्त्योऽसि भगवन्मया ॥
tr: keṣu keṣu ca bhāveṣu cintyo'si bhagavanmayā
en: How may I know you, Yogi, by constantly meditating on you? In what various forms, Lord, should I think of you?

sa: भूयः कथय तृप्तिर्हि श्रृण्वतो नास्ति मेऽमृतम् ॥
tr: bhūyaḥ kathaya tṛptirhi śrṛṇvato nāsti me'mṛtam
en: Tell me again in detail, Janardana, of your yoga and your glory, for I never tire of hearing your nectar-like words.
Very well, I will tell you of my divine glories, best of the Kurus, but only the chief ones, for there is no end to my extent.
speaker: Krishna said

sa: अहमादिश्च मध्यं च भूतानामन्त एव च ॥
tr: ahamādiśca madhyaṃ ca bhūtānāmanta eva ca
en: I am the Self, Gudakesha, seated in the heart of all beings; I am the beginning, the middle and the end of all beings.
Among the Adityas I am Vishnu; among lights, the radiant sun; among the winds I am Marichi; among the stars, the moon.
Among the Vedas I am the Sama Veda; among the gods, Indra; among the senses, the mind; and in living beings I am consciousness.
Among the Rudras I am Shankara; among yakshas and rakshasas, Kubera, lord of wealth; among the Vasus, fire; among mountains, Meru.

sa: पुरोधसां च मुख्यं मां विद्धि पार्थ बृहस्पतिम्।
tr: purodhasāṃ ca mukhyaṃ māṃ viddhi pārtha bṛhaspatim
en: Know me, Partha, as the chief of household priests, Brihaspati; among generals I am Skanda; among bodies of water, the ocean.
Among the great sages I am Bhrigu; among words, the single syllable Om; among sacrifices, the silent repetition of a name; among immovable things, the Himalaya.
Among all trees I am the sacred fig, the ashvattha; among divine sages, Narada; among the celestial musicians, Chitraratha; among the perfected, the sage Kapila.
Among horses, know me as Uchchaihshravas, born of the nectar; among lordly elephants, Airavata; and among men, the king.
Among weapons I am the thunderbolt; among cows, the wish-fulfilling Kamadhenu; I am Kandarpa, the god of love who begets; among serpents, Vasuki.
Among the nagas I am Ananta; among water beings, Varuna; among the ancestors, Aryaman; among those who govern, Yama.
Among the Daityas I am Prahlada; among those who measure, time; among beasts, the lion; among birds, Garuda, son of Vinata.
Among purifiers I am the wind; among wielders of weapons, Rama; among water creatures, the makara; among rivers, the Ganga.
Of all creations I am the beginning, the end and also the middle, Arjuna; among sciences, the knowledge of the Self; in those who debate, the reasoning.
Among letters I am the letter A; among compounds, the dual; I am also unending time, and I am the creator facing every direction.

sa: कीर्तिः श्रीर्वाक्च नारीणां स्मृतिर्मेधा धृतिः क्षमा ॥
tr: kīrtiḥ śrīrvākca nārīṇāṃ smṛtirmedhā dhṛtiḥ kṣamā
en: I am all-devouring death and the origin of what is yet to be; among feminine qualities I am fame, fortune, speech, memory, intelligence, steadfastness and patience.
Among hymns I am the Brihat Saman; among metres, the Gayatri; among months, Margashirsha; among seasons, flower-bearing spring.
I am the gambling of the cheats and the splendour of the splendid; I am victory, I am determination, I am the goodness of the good.
Among the Vrishnis I am Vasudeva; among the Pandavas, Dhananjaya; among sages, Vyasa; among poets, the poet Ushanas.
I am the rod of those who rule and the statecraft of those who seek victory; among secrets I am silence, and I am the knowledge of the knowers.

sa: न तदस्ति विना यत्स्यान्मया भूतं चराचरम् ॥
tr: na tadasti vinā yatsyānmayā bhūtaṃ carācaram
en: Whatever is the seed of all beings, that I am, Arjuna. There is no being, moving or unmoving, that could exist without me.
There is no end to my divine glories, scorcher of foes; what I have told you is only a sample of their extent.
Whatever is glorious, prosperous or powerful, know that it springs from a mere spark of my splendour.
But what need is there for you to know all this in detail, Arjuna? I stand, holding up this whole universe with a single fragment of myself.
